{{Top|leg}}
The '''Belligerency''' were the fourth highest social class on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Algara II]], below the [[Intelligentsia (Yinchorr)|Intelligentsia]]. They were the [[Algarian (race)|Algarians]] who served in the military. [[Onstruk Don]], leader of the [[Imperial Resistance]], was a former member of The Belligerency.
